hypothesis: On independent unseen BlockedUnlockPickup seeds, a bounded learned drop-occupancy action-effect memory will select a physically different safer relocation action when both adjacent sites are available, with strictly fewer real paid actions or greater official reward than the strongest equally informed blind right-first site control. Merely incrementing site counters, matching action traces, or tying scripted ceiling falsifies learning-specific value.
limits: Toy MiniGrid simulation, not learned general intelligence or native Yggdrasil advancement; inherited scripted navigation is identical for learned, blind and permuted arms; no token/transformer, no hidden MiniGrid state, no mission text, no environment identifiers at policy time, no free env.step.

design.environment: MiniGrid-BlockedUnlockPickup-v0 v3.2.0; gymnasium 1.4.0; numpy 2.3.4; Python 3.12; public 7x7x3 pixels/direction and actual paid actions/reward
design.training: One shared physical public-view expert trajectory for each of DoorKey6x6 and UnlockPickup, seeds 41,43,47,53,59,61 (six each), provided to all six arms; no BlockedUnlockPickup example in training
design.candidate: Learn from real paid pickup-clear and drop-place transitions; use the effect that dropping occupies a cell to project each candidate occupied site into the local public-view map and evaluate shortest reachable path from current estimated pose to observed door using BFS; choose site with shorter reachable route, tie right; if edge evidence absent choose right. No invented object-specific ball rule; same fixed inherited navigator after obstacle.
design.blind: Exact same public map/navigation, cost/actor capacity, shared training and actual actions; when both drop sides are free, take right-first physical site without consulting learned occupancy effect; forced side choices same as candidate.
design.permuted: Same counts and observations, but swap relevant drop effect with missing toggle-shift effect at action-selection time; no artificially disabled movement or reduced dataset.
design.md25: Unchanged actual prior MD25 learned site controller on same test cohort; no retroactive score editing.
design.conventional: Original fully trained tabular-Q and 12-hidden recurrent imitation controls, fed the same physical teacher trajectories and action budget.
design.provenance: At evaluation, capture exact per-env.step actions, public postaction observations, official reward and SHA. Decision counters only qualify if the next paid action visibly differs in independent trace. Cold model snapshot must be byte-identical. Do not inspect target seed outcomes before committing prereg and candidate code.
design.forbidden: No registered seed use on push/PR opened by default; no first-use workflow until full frozen preflight, no post-outcome threshold edits, no main or accepted refs updates

first_use_guard: When and only when every frozen toy/scoped CI gate passes: separately implement one-shot exact pre-registered draft PR opened registered study on exact source for both platforms; no automatic registered reruns; original artifacts only GitHub. No outcome-derived tuning.
